claims.evidence: Witness report shows assorted used car engine parts in a container, but no readable make/model/engine-type markings tying them to RX350.
No specific Lexus ES350 engine identifiers or part labels are shown in the witness observations.
Witness report does not show any part numbers/labels or engine-type indicators confirming IS250.
No Camry-specific engine markings or part numbers are visible in the described photos.

risks.risk: The parts may be mixed from different engines/vehicles (not a matched set for the claimed models), which changes compatibility and resale value.
risks.proof: A clear inventory/part list photo (or video) showing exact component types and quantities, plus any visible part numbers/labels on cylinder heads/blocks/alternators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed, unverified compatibility parts (worst-case: buyers must sort/verify fitment; assume no matched sets).

risks.risk: Condition uncertainty: internal damage (cracks, scoring, warped heads) and corrosion level are not shown; rusted container suggests possible harsh storage.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each cylinder head/block surface (combustion chambers, deck surface, oil/water passages) and any visible cracks/warping, plus photos of internal bores.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested used parts with potential defects (worst-case: treat as spares/for parts, not guaranteed serviceable).

risks.risk: Missing components: witness notes pulleys/belts/hoses removed, but completeness of assemblies is unknown.
risks.proof: A shot showing each assembly laid out with all included sub-parts visible (e.g., alternator with bracket, manifolds, sensors/hoses if claimed included), and a count/quantity list.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete assemblies (worst-case: missing key components; assume only what is visibly present).

risks.risk: No working/testing status: cannot confirm whether parts are functional (compression/leak-down/run test).
risks.proof: Video/clip of any testing (compression/leak-down) or proof of removal from running engine, plus any warranty/guarantee terms in writing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested parts (worst-case: assume not working / no guarantee).

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch risk: even if parts look Toyota/Lexus, engine family could differ (e.g., different displacements/variants), affecting fitment.
risks.proof: Photos of casting numbers/engine codes on cylinder heads/blocks (close and readable), and any ECU/sensor part numbers if included.
risks.if_unproven: Price for generic used engine components with compatibility risk (worst-case: buyer must verify casting numbers before purchase).

proof_requests: Send a full inventory list with quantities (cylinder heads, blocks, alternators, manifolds, pulleys) and which ones are included.
Provide close-up, readable casting numbers/part numbers on cylinder heads and blocks (and alternator/manifold labels if present).
Show photos of critical surfaces for cracks/warping (head deck, combustion chambers, block deck, bores) and corrosion level on internal passages.
Confirm whether parts are complete assemblies or mixed components; include photos showing what is missing from each assembly.
Provide any evidence of testing or removal from a running engine (video/receipt/warranty terms).
response.reason: The witness can confirm assorted used engine parts in a rusted container, but cannot confirm the specific vehicle models/engine types or completeness/condition. Without readable identifiers or an inventory, a worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
